content.value: Bismuth (melting point 520° F) and Cadmium (melting point 610° F) are assumed to be completely soluble in the liquid state and completely insoluble in the solid state. They form a eutectic at 290° F containing 40 percent Cadmium.
i) Draw the equilibrium diagram on a piece of graph paper labeling all points, lines, and areas.
ii) For an alloy containing 70 percent Cadmium give the chemical composition and relative amounts of the phases present at a temperature of 100° F bellow.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2015
